description: This file defines a web scraper class 'LekkerEnSimpel' for extracting recipe information from the 'lekkerensimpel.com' website, including methods for retrieving author, title, ingredients, instructions, and description.

classes.name: LekkerEnSimpel
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from lekkerensimpel.com

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author of the recipe from meta tags

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the recipe title

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts the list of ingredients from various possible HTML structures

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions from the page, handling multiple HTML structures

methods.name: description
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe description, falling back to meta description if schema is unavailable
